prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1093; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and has retained this firm to pursue the resulting claim. Please direct all further communication concerning this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with any other coverage that may apply to this loss. We also request that you disclose the identity of the adjuster assigned to the file.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle and telematics data, dash camera footage if any exists, and all correspondence with any party. We expect this material to be retained in its present form until the claim is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
